description: Fancy Yellow holds its colour most fully when white diamonds are set in immediate contrast, and the bracelet is built entirely on that principle. Each yellow oval is framed by white baguettes and micro-pavé round brilliants whose cool light pushes the warmth of the centre stones outward. Nothing in the piece competes with the yellow; every element is placed to amplify it. Stone after stone around the wrist, the line reads as one continuous run of colour in eighteen-karat gold.
